title: Indlela Yokukhuphela Iividiyo Neefoto ze-Pinterest kwi-Gallery
description: Indlela yokukhuphela iividiyo neefoto ze-Pinterest kwi-gallery yefowuni okanye kwi-laptop simahla, ngaphandle kwe-app nokungena. Landela amanyathelo alula.
body:
Wakhe wafumana ividiyo yeresiphi, ingcamango yokuhombisa, okanye isifundo esifutshane kwi-Pinterest uze ufune ukuyibukela kwakhona ngaphandle kwe-intanethi? Inqaku lokugcina le-Pinterest libeka i-Pin kwibhodi ngaphakathi kwe-app, ngoko ifayile ayingeni ngokwenene kwi-gallery yefowuni yakho. Kweli nqaku uza kufunda indlela yokukhuphela iividiyo ze-Pinterest neefoto ze-Pinterest kwi-gallery ngokulula, simahla, ngaphandle kwe-app eyongezelelweyo, nangaphandle kokungena.

Isixhobo esiza kusisebenzisa yi-I Need Save, isikhupheli esisebenza kwiwebhu onokusivula ngqo kwi-browser kwifowuni okanye kwi-laptop. Ngaphandle kwe-Pinterest, i-I Need Save ingasetyenziselwa nokuthunyelweyo okuvulelekileyo okuvela kwi-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), nakwamanye amaqonga.

Oko kufuneka ukulungiselele

  • Ilinki ye-Pin ofuna ukuyigcina. Qinisekisa ukuba loo Pin ivulelekile kuluntu.
  • Nayiphi na i-browser, umzekelo i-Chrome kwi-Android okanye i-Safari kwi-iPhone.
  • Uqhagamshelo lwe-intanethi oluzinzileyo, ingakumbi kwiividiyo ezinde.

Akufuneki uvule i-akhawunti kwi-I Need Save kwaye akufuneki ufake nayiphi na i-app.

Indlela yokukhuphela iividiyo ze-Pinterest kwifowuni

Amanyathelo ayafana kwi-Android nakwi-iPhone:

  1. Vula i-app ye-Pinterest uze ukhangele i-Pin yevidiyo oyifunayo.
  2. Cofa iqhosha elithi Yabelana (Share), uze ukhethe Kopa ilinki (Copy link).
  3. Vula i-browser uze undwendwele iphepha lokukhuphela le-I Need Save.
  4. Ncamathisela ilinki kwibhokisi ekhoyo, okanye ucofe nje iqhosha elithi Ncamathisela.
  5. Cofa Khuphela uze ulinde kancinci de kuvele ukhetho lweefayile.
  6. Khetha ukhetho olufunayo, umzekelo ividiyo ngomgangatho othile.

Ukuba iqhosha litshintsha libe ngu-Iyalungiselela…, ungalivali iphepha okwangoku. Kuthetha ukuba ividiyo iyasetyenzwa, umzekelo ividiyo nesandi sayo ziyadityaniswa okanye i-stream iguqulelwa kwi-MP4. Xa kugqityiwe, ukukhuphela kuya kuqala ngokuzenzekelayo.

Indlela yokugcina iifoto ze-Pinterest

Kwii-Pin eziyiifoto, indlela iphantse ifane. Kopa ilinki ye-Pin, uyincamathisele kwi-I Need Save, uze ucofe Khuphela. Kuluhlu lokhetho, khetha Ifoto okanye Umfanekiso omncinci. Olu khetho luluncedo nakuxa ufuna kuphela umfanekiso wesiciko we-Pin yevidiyo, umzekelo njengesalathiso soyilo lwakho.

Ukukhetha umgangatho wevidiyo ofanelekileyo

Emva kokucofa Khuphela, uya kudla ngokubona ukhetho lwemigangatho efana ne-360p, 720p, okanye 1080p. Ukhetho oluvelayo luxhomekeke kwividiyo yokuqala, ngoko ayizizo zonke ii-Pin ezinokhetho lwe-1080p.

  • 360p ilungile ukuba idatha yakho incinci okanye indawo yokugcina yefowuni iphantse yagcwala.
  • 720p lukhetho olulinganiselayo phakathi kokucaca nobukhulu befayile.
  • 1080p icace kakhulu, ilungele ukubukelwa kwisikrini esikhulu.

Ungafunda inkcazelo epheleleyo kwinqaku elithi umahluko phakathi komgangatho wevidiyo we-360p, 720p ne-1080p.

Ngaphandle kwevidiyo, kukho nokhetho oluthi Isandi. Ungathatha isandi ngomgangatho wokuqala, okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe kwividiyo. Kuluncedo ukuba into oyifunayo ngumculo ongasemva we-Pin kuphela.

Iifayile ze-Pinterest zigcinwa phi?

Indawo yefayile ixhomekeke kwisixhobo osisebenzisayo:

  • I-Android nekhompyutha: ifayile ingena kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). I-app ye-Gallery ngamanye amaxesha ifuna ixesha elincinci phambi kokuba iyibonise.
  • I-iPhone ne-iPad (Safari): ifayile ingena kwi-app ethi Files → Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). Ukuze ividiyo ingene kwi-app ethi Photos, vula ividiyo kwi-Files, cofa Share (Yabelana), uze ukhethe Save Video (Gcina Ividiyo).

Ukuba usadidekile ukufumana ifayile, landela isikhokelo esithi apho iifayile ezikhutshelweyo zigcinwa khona kwi-Android nakwi-iPhone.

Iifayile zithunyelwa ngqo zisuka kwi-Pinterest ziye kwisixhobo sakho kwaye azigcinwa kwiseva ye-I Need Save. Ngoko ke, gcina iifayile ezibalulekileyo kwindawo onokuyifumana lula kwakhona.

Ukuba ukukhuphela kwi-Pinterest akuphumelelanga

Kukho izinto ezimbalwa ezinokwenza inkqubo ingaphumeleli:

  • I-Pin ivela kwi-akhawunti yabucala okanye ibonakala kuphela emva kokungena.
  • Umxholo uthintelwe kwimimandla ethile.
  • Ilinki encanyathiselweyo ayiphelelanga okanye ikopwe kakubi.

Zama ukukopa kwakhona ilinki ngqo kwiqhosha elithi Yabelana, uze uphinde inkqubo. Khumbula ukuba umxholo wabucala, umxholo ofuna ukungena, nomxholo othintelwe ngokommandla ngokwenene awunakukhutshelwa.

Yisebenzise ngobulumko

Ii-Pin ezininzi ziqulethe imisebenzi yabanye abantu, njengeefoto, imizobo, okanye iividiyo ezenziwe ngabadali. Khuphela kuphela ukuze uzisebenzisele wena, umzekelo ukuyigcina njengesalathiso okanye ukuyibukela ngaphandle kwe-intanethi. Ukuba ufuna ukuyipapasha kwakhona, qala ucele imvume kumnini wayo uze ukhankanye igama lakhe.

Imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo

Ngaba ukukhuphela iividiyo ze-Pinterest kwi-I Need Save kusimahla?

Ewe, kusimahla. Vula nje isayithi kwi-browser, ngaphandle kwe-app nangaphandle kokungena.

Ingasetyenziswa kwi-laptop?

Ewe. Vula i-Pin kwi-browser ye-laptop, kopa ilinki yayo, uze uyincamathisele kwi-I Need Save. Ifayile iya kungena kwifolda ethi Downloads.

Kutheni ividiyo ingaveli kwangoko kwi-gallery?

Kwi-Android, i-Gallery ngamanye amaxesha ifuna ixesha elincinci ukuhlaziya uluhlu lweefayile. Kwi-iPhone, ividiyo kufuneka iqale igcinwe isuka kwi-app ethi Files iye kwi-Photos ngemenyu ethi Share.
